name: metamodel.changeProperty
title: Change property definition
summary: Change the name, description, value kind, fixed values or another field of a property, or whether a type requires it; only the metamodel files that have the definitions change, line by line.
details: Each given field replaces the line of that field in the property's definition, in the file it is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4); a missing field line is added after the definition's last line, and null removes it (`false` removes the line of `markdown`, `content` and `many`; a field that already has the value is left as it is). Every other line stays as it was; no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036), and the key stays (D-043). Name, description, maximum entries, target types, Markdown, part of the version and meaning change at any time; values that no longer fit are hints of the workspace check (SR-238 AK2). `type` with `required`: true adds the key to the type's own `required` list; false removes it from there and adds it to the type's own `properties` when the type would lose the property otherwise. A property the type does not have, and false for a property a parent type requires, are refused. `kind` and `many` change only while no element file of any type holds its key, also with an empty value (SR-236 AK7, SR-238 AK3), the count `metamodel.get` shows in `uses.properties`; with a new kind, the fixed values, target types, maximum entries and Markdown that do not belong to it are removed, as maximum entries are with `many: false`, and `dropped` names them. Fixed values are added at the end of `choices` with a name and an optional key (made from the name, SR-236 AK6), changed in name and description, and removed only while no element has the value (SR-238 AK4); a removed fixed value takes its lines and the comment lines directly above it. Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name a removed fixed value are listed in `mentions` and not changed (SR-236 AK7). The metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no property, type or fixed value has the key (details.property, details.type, details.choice); input.invalid with details.reason not-on-type when the type does not have the property; input.invalid with details.reason inherited when a parent type requires it (details.from); input.invalid with details.reason type-and-required when only one of `type` and `required` is given; input.invalid with details.reason kind-field when the input gives a field the value kind does not have: fixed values without kind `choice`, target types without `relation`, Markdown without `text`, maximum entries with `relation` (details.field, details.kind); input.invalid with details.reason single-value when `maxItems` is given for a property that holds a single value afterwards; input.invalid with details.reason change-and-remove when a fixed value is both in `changeChoices` and in `removeChoices` (details.property, details.choice); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another property or fixed value has the name, or a fixed value the key (details.field, details.key); input.invalid with details.reason key-required as metamodel.addProperty gives it for a fixed value; input.invalid with details.reason in-use when elements use what the change locks or removes (details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.folder-missing when such a change needs the uses and a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); file.faulty when an element file cannot be read, as it may hold the definition (SR-236 AK7, SR-008 AK3; details.command, details.count: the number of these files, details.files: the first 20 by repository and path, each with repository and file), when such a change needs the uses, unless a repository is missing as well; input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when a changed definition, or a node on the way to it, holds a YAML alias or anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

property.description: Key of the property to change.

name.description: New display name; no other property may have it.

description.description: New description, for people; null removes it.

kind.description: New value kind; only while no element file of any type holds its key, also with an empty value (SR-236 AK7).

many.description: true: the property holds a list of values; false removes the line. Only while no element file of any type holds its key, also with an empty value (SR-236 AK7).

maxItems.description: At most this many entries in the list (SR-171); null removes the limit.

targetTypes.description: Allowed target types of a property of kind `relation`; null removes the list: every type.

markdown.description: true: values are Markdown like the text (only kind `text`); false removes the line.

content.description: true: part of the version (D-013, D-057); false removes the line.

meaning.description: New built-in meaning (D-012), one of `propertyMeaning` of metamodel.schema.json; null removes it.

type.description: Key of a type that has the property, whose `required` changes; with `required`.

required.description: Whether the property is required in `type`; with `type`.

name.description: Display name of the fixed value; no other fixed value of the property may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of the value (D-043). Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

addChoices.description: Fixed values to add at the end of `choices`, in this order.

choice.description: Key of the fixed value to change.

name.description: New display name; no other fixed value of the property may have it.

changeChoices.description: Fixed values to change, by key.

removeChoices.description: Keys of fixed values to remove; only while no element has the value.

property.title: Property
property.description: The property's definition as written afterwards.

dropped.title: Removed fields
dropped.description: The fields removed because they do not belong to the new value kind, or maximum entries with `many: false` (SR-238 AK3).

mentions.title: Files naming a removed key

items.description: Saved filter, perspective or mapping file, relative to the workspace root; not changed.

mentions.description: Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name the key of a removed fixed value as a mapping key or text value, except their own name and description (SR-236 AK7). The key alone counts, so a file that uses the same word for another property is listed too.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
